test_cases.name: create_from_named_folders
test_cases.input: Create XTC items from the TC folders F-TC-10 and F-TC-11 under destination F-XTC-107
assertions: Creates one XTC per TC with title pattern 'title (TC-xx)'
Sets uplink from each XTC to its TC
Copies test steps into the XTC Test Case Steps field with empty result/comment
Copies Description, Test Setup, Test Method, and Test Level into the XTC Description
Copies non-empty Test Files to XTC Test Input Files

test_cases.name: create_from_folder_titles
test_cases.input: Generate executable test cases from the folders named System Tests V2.0 and Firmware Verification Tests into the v2.0.2 Verification folder
assertions: Places new XTCs in matching subfolders
Ignores any Out of Scope items

test_cases.name: handles_empty_steps
test_cases.input: Create XTCs from F-TC-10 under F-XTC-107; note that some TCs may have no steps
assertions: Creates the XTC and uplink even when the TC has no steps
Reports which items had no steps
